classification.description: The pytest framework makes it easy to write small tests, yet scales to support complex functional testing

plan.architecture_summary: Pytest is a mature, feature-rich testing framework for Python that makes it easy to write small tests and scales to complex functional testing. The codebase is structured with core package definitions under `src/pytest/` and internal implementations under `src/_pytest/`, with test suites located in `testing/`. Development and test environments are managed using `tox` and `uv`, supporting linting, documentation building, and comprehensive test suites across multiple Python versions.

setup_steps.title: Install uv
setup_steps.detail: Ensure uv is available for fast dependency installation.

setup_steps.title: Run test suite via tox
setup_steps.detail: Run tests using tox for the desired Python version or development environment.

setup_steps.title: Install pre-commit hooks
setup_steps.detail: Set up pre-commit hooks for linting and code formatting checks.

branch: Use standard feature/bugfix branches off main.
commit: Follow standard commit conventions and sign-off/DCO rules where applicable; use Co-authored-by trailers if AI tools are used.
pull_request: Fill out the PR template checklist, add tests for new features/bugfixes, include a changelog entry in `changelog/` for non-trivial changes, and add your name to `AUTHORS`.
code_style: Uses Ruff, Black, and pre-commit hooks as defined in pyproject.toml and .pre-commit-config.yaml.

issues.title: Unexpected behavior of skipping entire module when calling  unittest.skip("a")("b")
issues.why: A clear bug report involving the unittest plugin with python code and reproducible examples, well suited for a beginner wanting to explore pytest's unittest integration.
issues.approach: Investigate the issue where skipping entire modules happens unexpectedly when using unittest.skip with extra arguments, and fix the argument validation/handling logic in the unittest plugin.

issues.title: Test listed twice when there's an error during teardown
issues.why: An enhancement/bug reporting issue about duplicate test output listings during teardown errors, offering good exposure to pytest's runner and terminal reporting internals.
issues.approach: Examine how teardown errors interact with test outcomes and ensure reporting doesn't list tests redundantly when teardown exceptions occur.

issues.title: Vulnerable tmpdir handling (CVE-2025-71176)
issues.why: A security-relevant bug report with specific pointers to code lines, ideal for learning how temporary files and directories are managed safely in pytest.
issues.approach: Review and harden temporary directory handling heuristics in `src/_pytest/tmpdir.py` to address potential security issues (CVE-2025-71176).

first_timer_insights: Successful first-time PRs in pytest often touch files under `src/_pytest/` or documentation/changelogs, are concise and well-tested, include a changelog rst fragment, and add the contributor to `AUTHORS`.
caveats: Unsupervised agentic contributions are not accepted per project policy; contributors must understand and stand behind all submitted code and changes.
